description.en: The bucket of the data cache. The default value is default.

description.zh: 查询结果条数上限。默认值和最大值为20。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. The default value and the maximum value are both 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The query token. Set this to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call.

description.zh: 数据缓存对应Virtual Host的目录。
description.en: The directory in the virtual host that corresponds to the data cache.
